asset.name: Hyperliquid

score_rationales.supply: HYPE has a hard 1,000,000,000 max supply, but only 238,385,316 is circulating (24.8%), with substantial future unlock pressure still ahead (e.g., Core Contributors 23.8% allocation on cliff-plus-linear vesting and the next scheduled 9.92M unlock). Supply structure is mixed: community allocations are large (~70.2%), yet concentration risk remains from insider/foundation buckets and tracked large-holder wallets, while transparent treasury buckets (e.g., Future Emissions and Hyper Foundation) show a meaningful overhang versus float. Staking mechanics help reduce immediate sell pressure (10k validator self-delegation locked for 1 year, 1-day delegation lock, 7-day unstaking queue), but I keep exchange-reserve dynamics near-neutral because robust, time-series reserve outflow evidence for HYPE is still limited across major public dashboards.
